data.current_description:
Return retake-removal decisions for a project.

Status surfaces: queued / running / completed / failed. Decisions
(words/remove_spans/keep_intervals) are populated only when
status == "completed". The runner persists decisions at
workspaces/{ws}/jobs/{job}/artifacts/retake_removal/decisions.json.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve retake removal analysis results and status
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves the retake removal analysis results for a project, including the current job status and decision data. The response status indicates the analysis lifecycle: queued (waiting to start), running (in progress), completed (finished with decisions available), or failed (analysis encountered an error). Decision data (words to remove, remove_spans, and keep_intervals) is only populated when status equals "completed". Use this endpoint to poll for analysis completion and retrieve the final retake removal decisions.
